role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 愚蠢到成群结队的敌人将明白马格纳斯长角的恐怖。他身怀聚拢周围敌人的本领，运用强化的攻击毁灭他们，或者用他的长角将他们顶到无情的友军面前。
hero_summary_en: Enemies who are foolish enough to gather learn to fear the horn of Magnus. Able to pull nearby foes together, he can batter them with empowered attacks or skewer them with his horn to bring them before his merciless allies.

abilities.name: magnataur_shockwave
abilities.description_zh: 马格纳斯放出一道能量波，对一条直线上的敌方单位造成伤害，并将他们朝自身牵引，同时受到短暂减速效果。
abilities.description_en: Magnus sends out a wave of force, damaging enemy units in a line, pulling them towards him, and slowing them for a brief period.
facet_text_en: Increases the max level of Shockwave. Level %max_level% Shockwave causes it to return towards Magnus's current location after reaching max length. The return Shockwave travels %return_shockwave_bonus_distance% distance further and hits enemies a second time for %return_damage_pct_tooltip%%% of the damage.
facet_text_zh: 提升震荡波的最高等级。%max_level%级震荡波会在到达最大长度后会返回至马格纳斯的当前位置。返回的震荡波行进距离增加%return_shockwave_bonus_distance%，对再次击中敌人并造成%return_damage_pct_tooltip%%%伤害。

abilities.name: magnataur_empower
abilities.description_zh:
对友军施放时，给予攻击力加成并使其获得分裂效果。

授予力量总是在马格纳斯身上生效，拥有%self_multiplier%%%额外效果。
abilities.description_en:
When cast on an ally, grants them bonus damage and cleave on attack. 

 Empower is always on Magnus with %self_multiplier%%% larger bonus.
notes_zh: 攻击力加成根据基础攻击力和主属性加成计算。
分裂伤害无视减益免疫。
远程单位的攻击没有分裂效果。
notes_en: The bonus damage is based only on base damage and damage from primary attributes.
Cleave damage goes through spell immunity.

abilities.name: magnataur_skewer
abilities.description_zh: 马格纳斯向前冲刺，用他巨大的犀角将敌人挑起。被击中的英雄将被拽至终点，然后受到伤害并且移动速度被减缓。根据行进的距离伤害也会提升。
abilities.description_en: Magnus rushes forward, goring enemy units on his massive tusk. Heroes hit on the way will be dragged to the destination, then damaged and affected by slowed movement speed. The damage is increased based on distance traveled.
notes_zh: 马格纳斯受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时，巨角冲撞都会被打断。
notes_en: Skewer is interrupted if Magnus is stunned, hexed or banished.

shard_loc.en: Increases range and deals additional damage when skewering enemies into trees or cliffs.
shard_loc.zh: 提升距离，并且使敌人穿过树木和高台时造成额外伤害。

abilities.name: magnataur_horn_toss
abilities.description_zh: 马格纳斯顶起前方的敌人，将其甩在身后。敌人受到伤害，滞空%air_duration%秒并处于眩晕状态，而且落地后还会眩晕一段时间。
abilities.description_en: Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend %air_duration% seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.

abilities.name: magnataur_solid_core
abilities.description_zh: 马格纳斯的减速抗性得到提升，并且受到敌人技能和物品的击退效果减少。
abilities.description_en: Magnus has increased slow resistance and suffers less knockback from enemy's abilities and items.

abilities.name: magnataur_reverse_polarity
abilities.description_zh: 马格纳斯改变物质的属性，将附近的敌人拖拽至他的前方，并且以震击对他们造成伤害和眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Magnus changes properties of matter, pulling all nearby enemies in front of him and stunning them with a damaging slam.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_magnus_reverse_polarity_stats
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_stats_per_stack} All Attributes per hero hit with Reverse Polarity

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_magnus_2
talents_raw.desc_loc: The Returning Shockwave deals {s:bonus_return_damage_pct}% damage and travels an extra {s:bonus_return_shockwave_bonus_distance} distance.
